entries.title: Exodus 27:2
segments: Horns; projections of the four corners.

entries.title: Exodus 27:4
segments: A grate of network of brass; the position and office of this it is difficult to determine. A common opinion has been, that it was suspended by the four rings in the hollow of the altar midway between the top and the bottom; and that on it the sacrifices were burned, the ashes falling through upon the ground below.  Others have supposed that all the hollow of the altar above the grave was filled with earth, upon which the sacrifices were placed.  The common Jewish tradition is, that the whole interior of the altar was filled with earth,
, and that the grate went round the altar on the outside, which is favored by

entries.title: Exodus 27:8
segments: Every altar for sacrifice, erected by divine appointment under the Old Testament, pointed forward to the sacrifice of Christ; who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot unto God, to purge our consciences from dead works to serve the living God.

entries.title: Exodus 27:9
segments: Court of the tabernacle; a large open inclosure around the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 27:10
segments: Fillets; rods passing from the top of one pillar to another.

entries.title: Exodus 27:13
segments: On the east side eastward; as this was the front, it had a gateway in the centre of twenty cubits, with a hanging of richer materials, leaving just fifteen cubits on each side for the curtain of common materials.

entries.title: Exodus 27:17
segments: Filleted with silver; connected at the top by silver fillets.

entries.title: Exodus 27:20
segments:
Oil-olive beaten; oil obtained from beating olives in a mortar, which was more pure than that obtained by pressing them in a mill. 
 
Intelligence and purity should ever characterize the followers, and especially the ministers of Christ.  He is the light of the world, and in following him they will not walk in darkness, but have the light of life, and be instrumental in communicating it for the salvation of their fellow-men.

entries.title: Exodus 27:21
segments: Order it; see to the lighting of the lamp, according to divine direction.
